annotations.text:
Both top artboards are live — click the tabs and the swatches.

Tabs: each lifts, tilts a degree toward you, and blooms in its own hue. The panel slides up behind it.

Swatches (bottom right of the workspace, and all of Settings) re-tint the whole surface.
The numbers, so the build matches the mockup instead of approximating it. One easing curve — cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1) — across every transition.
